rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a period of reduced economic activity, including a technically defined recession.

example.english: This recession has forced many companies to freeze hiring.
example.traditional: 呢次經濟衰退令好多公司都要凍結招聘。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 ging1 zai3 seoi1 teoi3 ling6 hou2 do1 gung1 si1 dou1 jiu3 dung3 git3 ziu1 ping3

rows.note: Use this more colloquial expression for a generally weak economic climate when statistical precision is not important.

example.english: With the economy in recession, finding a job has become much harder.
example.traditional: 而家經濟不景，搵工真係難咗好多。
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 ging1 zai3 bat1 ging2 wan2 gung1 zan1 hai6 naan4 zo2 hou2 do1
